reddit_quotes: I've used Pilot Custom Heritage for 7 months. Not worth the premium.
Pilot Custom Heritage is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Pilot Custom Heritage community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Pilot Custom Heritage after two weeks. It feels overpriced for what it is.
